name: Batch Meal Prep for the Week
equipment: A sheet pan, a large pot, and 6+ containers
instructions: Cook 2 proteins, 2 starches, and 3 vegetables in parallel (oven + stovetop) so everything finishes around the same time.
Keep components separate rather than fully assembled meals -- it is easier to mix and match through the week and avoids soggy leftovers.
Cool everything to room temperature before sealing containers, then refrigerate; this keeps food safe and prevents condensation buildup.
Label each container with the date -- most cooked components keep well for 4 days in the fridge.
